versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0

- Create Chinese or English flashcards from user-supplied local text, with exact source quotes and paragraph IDs.
- Validate cards and export Markdown, Anki TSV, and a manual review checklist.
- Keep processing local: scripts use Node core modules and do not call external services or sync learning accounts.
- Reject invalid or unsafe inputs and avoid inventing unsupported facts.
